ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, characterized by a dominant white field with narrow black margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white across the medial and lateral regions. A continuous low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge. A distinct vertical dark linear cluster is located approximately 5% left of the median notch. Dark, irregular geometric clusters are concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations at the distal tips of both lobes. Moderate-frequency, low-amplitude undulating peaks along the mid-sections of the trailing edge. Distinct jagged indentation on the far left trailing edge tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; the inner margin near the notch displays a convex trajectory transitioning to a pronounced concave upturn toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips, appearing as irregular, roughly circular aggregations against the white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent dark vertical linear disruption extending from the trailing edge toward the base on the left lobe. Several faint, parallel vertical pixel streaks are visible on the lower-center left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring on the trailing edge of the left lobe tip; dark pigmented scarring at the right lobe tip suggesting historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse low-intensity yellowish-brown pixel staining (diatom film) visible on the lower-medial sections of the left lobe.
